title: Pozole rojo
ingredients: 2 lb pork shoulder or chicken thighs, chunked
2 dried guajillo or ancho chiles, stemmed
Cabbage, radish, lime, oregano, chips or tostadas
steps: Simmer meat with half the onion and garlic in salted water until tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Shred; keep the broth.
Toast chiles, soak in hot water 15 minutes, then blend with remaining onion, garlic, and spices. Strain into the pot.
Add hominy and meat. Simmer 20 minutes. Season.
